stem: Which argument was made by Anti-Federalists such as Patrick Henry?

options.label: A
options.text: Constructing a strong central government is necessary to protect the rights of the upper class.

options.label: B
options.text: The Constitution needs to outline individual rights that are to be protected.

options.label: C
options.text: Ratifying the Constitution is necessary in order to protect states’ rights.

options.label: D
options.text: The separation of powers within the government will help limit individual rights.
